source: Arbaʿīn — Introduction, notes after the CLAUDE marker

cards.meaning: the phrase that separates the opening praise from the body of an address
the separation of speech — the function performed by أَمَّا بَعْدُ

cards.front: What is the technical term for what أَمَّا بَعْدُ does?
cards.back: فَصْل الخِطَاب — the separation of speech

cards.front: Where in an address does أَمَّا بَعْدُ come?
cards.back: After the ḥamd and the salām, before the body
